resources.string: FaceAttend keeps your school\'s attendance on its FaceAttend server: the school computer or the online service. Connect this phone once; the app remembers it.
Check that FaceAttend is running on the computer and that this phone has internet (online link) or is on the same Wi-Fi.

Where is the QR code? On the school computer: FaceAttend icon next to the clock → Connect phones → Share online. It works on mobile data and any Wi-Fi.
The computer must be on with FaceAttend running (it starts with Windows). If sharing is restarted, scan the new QR code.
